dedupe_keys.name: hourly water demand forecasting analysis code

description: The analysis team publishes Python code for comparing hourly demand forecasts in a metropolitan water-distribution system. Zenodo archives version 1.0 under MIT and links a public repository. Its README lists seven forecast models, blocked temporal cross-validation, seasonal tests, residual checks and scripts for result tables. A user can supply a semicolon-delimited hourly demand CSV with the documented timestamp and flow columns and adapt reservoir labels. The code can benchmark demand-forecast methods for water-service operation. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this reusable procedure. Coverage is a modelling workflow, not the original operator series: the README says proprietary hourly data are withheld and only aggregate results are published. A limitation is that users cannot reproduce the paper numbers without those private series; the linked article is described as under review. The code was not run on substitute data and model accuracy was not checked.
